classes.name: Vegetarian pizza
axioms: owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( <http://example.org/expressions#Pizza> [ a owl:Class ; owl:complementOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasTopping> ; owl:someValuesFrom <http://example.org/expressions#MeatTopping> ] ] ) ]

classes.name: Adult person
axioms: rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( <http://example.org/expressions#Person> [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasAge> ; owl:someValuesFrom [ a rdfs:Datatype ; owl:onDatatype xsd:integer ; owl:withRestrictions ( [ xsd:minInclusive "18"^^xsd:integer ] ) ] ] ) ]

classes.name: Grandparent
axioms: owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasChild> ; owl:someValuesFrom [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasChild> ; owl:someValuesFrom <http://example.org/expressions#Person> ] ]

classes.name: Member
axioms: rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty [ owl:inverseOf <http://example.org/expressions#hasMember> ] ; owl:someValuesFrom <http://example.org/expressions#Organisation> ]

classes.name: Twin
axioms: rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasSibling> ; owl:qualifiedCardinality "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ; owl:onClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( <http://example.org/expressions#Person> [ a owl:Class ; owl:complementOf <http://example.org/expressions#Organisation> ] ) ] ]

rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty <http://example.org/expressions#hasChild> ; owl:allValuesFrom [ a owl:Class ; owl:unionOf ( <http://example.org/expressions#Person> <http://example.org/expressions#Place> ) ] ]
